notes: 2-storey 1915 timber industrial front (DataSF footprint; its rear footprint is the OSM Clementina building). Dark green horizontal clapboard, a pair of tall black carriage doors with a glazed top row on the left, an orange steel-grille door and a small window right; upper storey four double-hung windows in white-grey frames. Lighter grey-green clapboard (read near-black olive). Paired black carriage doors with a glazed top row (garage material "carriage") instead of a roll-up; cornice. Painted-clapboard in grey-green with visible board lines. Greyer green clapboard (read saturated green). Street grime: soot at the base, grime, faint wide streaks. Darker slate green-grey clapboard. No cream belt course between storeys, sash frames the same dark green as the boards. A closed orange-red door behind a diamond scissor gate (the open recess with a curtain read wrong).
